spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying near Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.

entries.task_id: the buddha|pointed|with his right arm and said to the king
entries.description: the Buddha pointed with his right arm and said to the king
entries.subject: the Buddha
entries.object: with his right arm and said to the king

spans.text: Atha kho bhagavā dakkhiṇaṁ bāhuṁ paggahetvā rājānaṁ pasenadiṁ kosalaṁ etadavoca: Then the Buddha pointed with his right arm and said to the king, “eso, mahārāja, aṅgulimālo”ti.

entries.task_id: the buddha|said|to him
entries.description: the Buddha said to him
entries.subject: the Buddha

spans.text: Atha kho bhagavā rājānaṁ pasenadiṁ kosalaṁ bhītaṁ saṁviggaṁ lomahaṭṭhajātaṁ viditvā rājānaṁ pasenadiṁ kosalaṁ etadavoca: Knowing this, the Buddha said to him, “mā bhāyi, mahārāja, natthi te ito bhayan”ti.
The Buddha said to him, “idhāhaṁ, bhante, pubbaṇhasamayaṁ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiṁ piṇḍāya pāvisiṁ.

entries.task_id: venerable aṅgulimāla|lived|in the wilderness
entries.description: Venerable Aṅgulimāla lived in the wilderness
entries.subject: Venerable Aṅgulimāla

spans.text: But at that time Venerable Aṅgulimāla lived in the wilderness, ate only almsfood, and owned just three robes.

spans.text: Atha kho āyasmā aṅgulimālo rājānaṁ pasenadiṁ kosalaṁ etadavoca: So he said to the king, “alaṁ, mahārāja, paripuṇṇaṁ me cīvaran”ti.

entries.description: and said to him
entries.subject: and

spans.text: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca: Then the king went back to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him, “acchariyaṁ, bhante, abbhutaṁ, bhante.

spans.text: How the Buddha tames those who are wild, pacifies those who are violent, and extinguishes those who are unquenched!
